module: Displays a 3D GPS arrow (TSStatic art/shapes/interface/s_mm_arrow_floating.dae) floating in front of the camera, at the location of the arrowGPS interface app, and oriented toward a world target. Several sources can register a target with a priority (setTarget); the highest-priority one (smallest number) is followed. The arrow is created on demand, hidden if there is no target or no player vehicle, and deleted on unload.
notes: Priority: the smallest value wins (comparison "reg.priority < bestPriority").
setTarget accepts pos as vec3, {x,y,z} or {1,2,3}. A registration without pos is ignored when choosing the active target. color = {r,g,b} with values from 0 to 1, default {1, 0.4, 0.2}.

The app's screen position (0 to 1) is set on the Vue side by setAppScreenPos; the arrow is placed at arrowDepth (0.15 m by default) in front of the camera, taking the FOV and the screen ratio into account.
Default scale 0.04. The arrow stays hidden if the player has no vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) or if the target is less than 0.1 m away.

setTarget.desc: Registers or replaces a source's target (key) with its priority, then recomputes the active target and the arrow's color.

removeTarget.desc: Removes a source's target and recomputes the active target (the arrow hides if none remains).

setAppScreenPos.desc: Sets the app's screen position (fractions from 0 to 1) where the arrow is drawn; called from the interface side.

setScale.desc: Changes the arrow's scale (0.04 by default).

setDepth.desc: Changes the distance in front of the camera at which the arrow is placed (0.15 by default).

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before each render: creates the arrow if needed, computes its screen-to-world position, orients it toward the active target (quatFromDir) and shows it; hides it if there is no target or no player vehicle.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: deletes the arrow object and empties all registrations.
